related.title: NuScale US600 模組設計研究
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「自然循環的驅動壓頭」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；NuScale US600 模組設計研究的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Driving head of natural circulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of NuScale US600 modular design study must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦阿根廷自主設計的一體化原型堆：自穩壓、爐內蒸汽產生器、自然循環與放大的經濟性；NuScale US600 模組設計研究則以一體化模組的定量檢核：自然循環、整體效應試驗、共用水池熱沉與首座計畫的成本為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on argentina's own integral prototype: self-pressurisation, in-vessel steam generators, natural circulation and the economics of scaling up; NuScale US600 modular design study centres on quantitative checks of an integral module: natural circulation, integral testing, the shared pool as heat sink and the cost of the first project, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「不用加熱器的自穩壓」的模型移到NuScale US600 模組設計研究，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「縮尺整體效應試驗的功率比例」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Self-pressurisation without heaters" to NuScale US600 modular design study, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Power scaling in a reduced-scale integral test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「自然循環的驅動壓頭」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；NuScale US600 模組設計研究的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Driving head of natural circulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of NuScale US600 modular design study must be respecified.

related.title: 玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆
related.titleEn: Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor

related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Driving head of natural circulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor must be respecified.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on argentina's own integral prototype: self-pressurisation, in-vessel steam generators, natural circulation and the economics of scaling up; Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor centres on the first land-based commercial small modular PWR: an integral vessel, single-lift core module and cogeneration with desalination, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「不用加熱器的自穩壓」的模型移到玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Self-pressurisation without heaters" to Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「自然循環的驅動壓頭」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Driving head of natural circulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor must be respecified.

history.title: CAREM-25 一體化壓水原型堆
history.text: 1984 年設計概念首次對外發表；2014 年原型堆開工；2019 年工程因合約與預算問題停頓；2020 年工程恢復；2024 年政府再度暫停計畫。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1984: The design concept was first presented. 2014: Construction of the prototype began. 2019: Work stopped over contract and budget problems. 2020: Work resumed. 2024: The government paused the project again. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
